The project is ready and good to go. However, we will slightly modify the main function to give users a working interface.

1import numpy as np
2
3# initialize student records with random value
4def initialize_data():
5    # create a subject array
6    subject = np.array(['English', 'Maths', 'Science', 'Social', 'History'])
7    # create a student array
8    students = np.array(['Alice', 'Bob', 'Charlie', 'Dan'])
9    marks = np.array([[81, 78, 80, 60, 63],
10                      [50, 40, 65, 48, 65],
11                      [30, 83, 97, 97, 75],
12                      [99, 55, 60, 58, 30]])
13
14    # generate random marks for each student and subject
15    # marks = np.random.randint(30, 101, size=(len(students), len(subject)))
16
17    return subject, students, marks
18
19# add new student record by taking input from user
20def add_record(studentArray, subjectArray, marksArray):
21    print('\n Add New Student Data\n')
22    # get student's name
23    studentName = input('Student Name : ')
24    # initialize an empty marks array of same length as subject
25    marks = np.empty(len(subjectArray), dtype=int)
26    # get inputs from the user
27    for i in range(len(subjectArray)):
28        marks[i] = int(input(f"Enter marks for {subjectArray[i]}: "))
29    # append new student to studentArray
30    studentArray = np.append(studentArray, studentName)
31    # append marks of new student to studentArray
32    marksArray = np.vstack((marksArray, marks))
33    return studentArray, marksArray
34
35# display the record in visually pleasing form
36def display_record(studentArray, subjectArray, marksArray):
37    
38    # create a new Array for Total, Average and Result    
39    # calculate total marks for each student
40    totalArray = np.sum(marksArray, axis=1)
41    # calculate average marks for each student
42    avgArray = np.mean(marksArray, axis=1)
43    # check if all marks in a row are >= 40 and assign 'Pass' or 'Fail' accordingly
44    resultArray = np.where(np.all(marksArray >= 40, axis=1), 'Pass', 'Fail')
45    
46    # add Total, Average and Grade to header
47    headerArray = np.hstack(('Student/Subject', subjectArray, np.array(['Total', 'Average', 'Result'])))
48    header = "|".join(headerArray)
49    print(header)
50    
51    # create a lengthArray for formatting purpose
52    lengthArray = np.array([len(element) for element in headerArray])
53    
54    # print the separator line
55    separator = "+".join(["-" * length for length in lengthArray])
56    print(separator)
57    
58    # print the marks for each student
59    for i, student in enumerate(studentArray):
60        row = f"{student :<{lengthArray[0]}}"
61        row += ''.join(f"|{mark:<{lengthArray[col+1]}}" for col, mark in enumerate(marksArray[i]))
62        # add Total, Average and Pass result for each student
63        row += "|" + f"{totalArray[i]:<{lengthArray[6]}}" 
64        row += "|" + f"{avgArray[i]:<{lengthArray[7]}}" 
65        row += "|" + f"{resultArray[i]:<{lengthArray[8]}}" 
66        print(row)
67    print(separator)
68
69def obtain_results(studentArray, subjectArray, marksArray):
70    
71    # data part
72    #  average marks for each subject
73    avgSubject = np.mean(marksArray, axis=0)
74    
75    # deviation and variation of marks
76    stdSubject = np.std(marksArray, axis = 0)
77    varSubject = np.var(marksArray, axis = 0)
78    stdStudents = np.std(marksArray, axis = 1)
79    varStudents = np.var(marksArray, axis = 1)
80    
81    # top and bottom performing student 
82    topPerformer =  studentArray[np.argmax(np.sum(marksArray, axis=1))]
83    bottomPerformer =  studentArray[np.argmin(np.sum(marksArray, axis=1))]
84    
85    # subject comparison
86    easiestSubject = subjectArray[np.argmax(avgSubject)]
87    hardestSubject = subjectArray[np.argmin(avgSubject)]
88    
89    # overall performance
90    totalAverage = np.mean(marksArray)
91    totalStd = np.std(marksArray)
92    totalVar = np.var(marksArray)
93    
94    # analysis and visualization part
95    # total number of students
96    print('Total Number of students: ', len(studentArray))
97    
98    # average marks for each subject
99    print('\nAverage Marks in Each Subject')
100    for i,subject in enumerate(subjectArray):
101        print('\t',subject,':', avgSubject[i])
102    
103    # deviation and variation of marks
104    print('\nStandard Deviation and Variance per Subject')
105    header = np.array(['Subject Name','Standard Deviation','Variance'])
106    print("|".join(header))
107    # print the separator line
108    separator = "+".join(["-" * len(item) for item in header])
109    print(separator)
110    for i, subject in enumerate(subjectArray):
111        row = f"{subject :<{len(header[0])}}" +'|'+ f"{stdSubject[i] :<{len(header[1])}}" + '|' + f"{varSubject[i] :<{len(header[2])}}"
112        print(row) 
113    
114    print('\nStandard Deviation and Variance per Student')
115    print("|".join(header))
116    # print the separator line
117    print(separator)
118    for i, student in enumerate(studentArray):
119        row = f"{student :<{len(header[0])}}" +'|'+ f"{stdStudents[i] :<{len(header[1])}}" + '|' + f"{varStudents[i] :<{len(header[2])}}"
120        print(row)
121   
122    # top and bottom performing student 
123    print('\nTop performer: ', topPerformer)
124    print('Bottom performer:', bottomPerformer)
125    
126    # subject comparison
127    print('\nEasiest Subject:',easiestSubject, '\nHardest Subject:',hardestSubject)
128    
129    # overall performance
130    print('\nMetrics across all Students and Subjects')
131    print('Average Marks: ',totalAverage, '\nStandard Deviation: ',totalStd, '\nVariance: ',totalVar)
132    
133def main():
134    subject, students, marks = initialize_data()
135    while(1):
136        print('-'* 75)
137        choice = int(input('1. Press 1 to Display Student Results\n2. Press 2 to Add a new Student Record\n3. Press 3 to Display Analyzed Results\n4. Press 4 to Exit\n\n'))
138        print('-'* 75)
139        if(choice == 1):
140            display_record(students, subject, marks)
141        elif(choice == 2):
142            students,marks = add_record(students, subject, marks)
143        elif(choice == 3):
144            obtain_results(students, subject, marks)
145        elif(choice == 4):
146            break;
147        else:
148            print('Invalid Choice')
149main()
Now, our project is complete. However, we can refactor the code to make it look and perform better.
